findings.problem: 'X हो सकते हैं' (may contain X) is permissive; the English states the exhaustive rule and the context note forbids softening. The restriction is only implied by the error state.

findings.problem: Intransitive form; its twins use the passive 'बनाया/सहेजा नहीं जा सका'. Correct and natural, only a parallelism nit.
